name: Fireburst (Orphaned Bookworm Productions)
body:
School evocation [fire]; Level bloodrager 2, magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2

EFFECT

Range 10 ft.

This spell functions as lesser fireburst except it has a wider burst radius and deals 1d8 fire damage per caster level (maximum 5d8).
